slots.title: Binance users in some European countries told to pull crypto before fees kick in, with accounts closing by year end
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Affected accounts are reportedly set to close on Dec. 31. Users in Spain, France, and Poland say they've received similar notices.

slots.title: U.S. Treasury moves to cut off crypto exchange MEXC over $16 billion in alleged illicit flows
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Treasury billed the move as part of its campaign against Iran, but the order rests on MEXC's alleged role in Russian illicit finance.

slots.title: Amazon’s new basic Kindle proves you don’t need all the bells and whistles
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Amazon's redesigned basic Kindle costs more than before, but its lighter build and improved display make a compelling case for skipping the pricier models.

slots.title: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card numbers, home addresses and linked crypto wallets
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: One user said the exposed data tied his home address and card number to every crypto wallet linked to his account, raising the risk of targeted scams.

slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: As parents look for alternatives to unrestricted smartphones, a growing number of companies are building phones designed specifically for kids, from feature-limited mobile devices to minimalist home phones.
